service.description: Indexes one run's live extract file for its tenant connection (handed over by both run paths, in the background). A failure is logged; the run is never touched.

parameter.name: readStartedAt
parameter.description: OC158: when the run began reading (before the fetch); decides over the file's modified time whether a drop of the connection's kept data came after the read.

service.description: The maintain_IdIndex_nightly job (seeded paused): indexes every kept copy whose current version the index has not (first load, a failed pass, a changed tenant field), then drops rows no read has seen for darpan.idindex.months.
